review: Production topics need a practical container/CI path, infrastructure ownership, secrets, gradual rollout, and budget arithmetic before scale claims.
build: Package a synthetic API and worker with declared configuration, managed secrets, migrations, and automated checks. Deploy to a disposable environment, then rehearse rollback and restore.
verify: A clean build starts without baked-in credentials; CI rejects a deliberate regression; old and new versions coexist during rollout; restore meets a measured recovery target on the fixture.
